text:
anya: Quick dump — ran the canary with kernel-selector tweak (heuristic v4) and separated prefill/decode queues. Perf regressed on 512-token gen workloads.

anya: Summary: 3–4% higher p95 latency, throughput on 13B down ~6% when KV warmup is cold.

jordan: :eyes: Do you have the flamegraphs? Where's the time going — kernel switch or queue wait?

anya: Attached flame slices (short): kernel_select() spikes, but most of the extra time is in 'kv_rehash' during decode when prefill priming isn't allowed to finish.

lee: Hmm — sounds like KV thrash from interleaved prefill/decode. We saw similar when token budget was too tight and batches kept switching.

sam: Can we try bumping token_budget_target for prefill batches to insist on finishing priming before handoff? Try 128 -> 256 for a probe.

anya: Doing that now. Running perf harness: ```python infra/perf/run_bench.py --model=redwood-13b --scenario=long-gen --connect=local --kernel-heuristic=v4 --prefill_token_target=256 --separate_queues=1``` 

ci-bot: perf-run 4250001120 started (bench id: pr-1228). ETA ~12m.

jordan: Also try lowering decode priority slightly so prefill can grab KV warmup window. Phase-aware scheduling param 'phase_priority_bias' = +0.2 for prefill?

lee: If we do that we need to watch short-request latency — might increase user-visible latencies for interactive flows. Maybe do canary routing only for long-gen tier.

ci-bot: perf-run 4250001685 completed. Results: throughput -4.8%, p95 +1.9% with prefill_target=256; with phase_priority_bias=+0.2, throughput -2.1%, p95 +0.6%. Full logs: http://ci.internal/runs/pr-1228

anya: Interesting. Biasing priority helps. We still see kernel_select overhead; might need to cache kernel mapping results longer (kernel_map_ttl) to avoid re-eval on batch boundary.

sam: Agree. Propose: 1) keep separate queues, 2) prefill_token_target=256, 3) phase_priority_bias=+0.15, 4) kernel_map_ttl=5s. Rollout to canary (10% riders) and monitor KV hit-rate and end-to-end p95.

jordan: +1. Add a probe metric: kv_hit_rate_by_phase and kernel_selector_miss_rate.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary deploy at 2026-03-19T02:00Z to cluster infer-canary-3 (10%).

anya: I'll create an RFC with the numbers and a small graph; will paste after I convert perf logs.

sam: Thanks — if canary looks good, we can promote with fallback to legacy kernel heuristic.

anya: ok, will follow up with raw plots. :thumbsup:
